filename: Groundwater rivals aridity in determining global photosynthesis.pdf
title: Groundwater rivals aridity in determining global photosynthesis
code_availability: All analyses were performed using R Statistical Software. Specific analysis scripts are not mentioned as publicly archived.
testbed_rationale: This study conducts offline ML analysis of multi-year time-averaged satellite and reanalysis fields to assess driver contributions via SHAP, rather than offering high-frequency benchmark simulation or parameterization datasets.
pain_points: Temporal mismatch between datasets: modelled water table depth was evaluated over 2004–2014, whereas SIF data covered 2018–2021.
Data gaps in satellite SIF products across mountainous areas and deserts.
Lower data quality and sparser in situ well observations for groundwater table depth outside of CONUS.
Confounding anthropogenic processes such as irrigation in croplands obscuring clear groundwater and aridity dependencies.
extraction_notes: XGBoost models predict the ratio of multi-year mean SIF to PAR using moisture index and water table depth as inputs for each plant functional type group.
